name: 92657 · Newport Coast, CA
findings: ZIP 92657 (Newport Coast) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92657 (Newport Coast) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92657 (Newport Coast) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

observations.text: 14 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
